findings.correction: Consumers remain unsubmitted until all semantic predecessors succeed; failure propagates through joins while accepted resources remain retained.
findings.closure_cases: Fail A before B uses its output as an index; repeat for joins, cross-queue graphs, partial acceptance and collective consumers.

findings.correction: Safe APIs transfer storage to a runtime registry or use a non-escaping supervisor scope; forgetting a handle cannot end retention.
findings.closure_cases: Forget futures, attempt scope escape, panic/cancel/timeout and lose replies without allowing caller reuse before quiescence.

findings.correction: A bounded acceptance window and contiguous retirement watermark distinguish new out-of-order IDs from permanently retired ones; queries never remint ownership.
findings.closure_cases: Test stalled holes, replay after retirement, live dependents, duplicate redemption, quotas and generation rollover.

findings.correction: Initial inputs, body inputs, backedge outputs and final body-defined values have separate mappings; outer Select supplies source while results.
findings.closure_cases: Compile and execute 0/1/multiple/nested/early-exit accumulator fixtures and reject fictitious Loop node-output references.

findings.correction: Chain-dependent semantics require supported and enabled availability/visibility chains, or a separately proved/enforced chain-free restriction.
findings.closure_cases: Reject missing-chain-feature capability fixtures before dispatch and qualify direct/multi-hop publication litmus cases.

findings.correction: One session owner serializes Vulkan queue, pool, descriptor, mapping and lifetime operations; callbacks use a specified reentrancy path.
findings.closure_cases: Exercise concurrent record/submit/reset/free, callback reentry, shutdown races and error unwinding with host/API diagnostics.

findings.correction: Result schema v2 carries namespaced policy identity plus definition digest; protected admission retains immutable old meanings.
findings.closure_cases: An unchanged reader accepts an admitted fourth policy and rejects unadmitted identities, wrong digests and self-admission; preserve v1 decoding.

findings.correction: Tail estimands, independent sampling units, exact order-statistic bounds, multiplicity/looks and inadequate-data rejection are specified.
findings.closure_cases: Reject the 30-block fast-only sample as inadequate; validate binomial rank bounds, ties, zero denominators, confidence allocation and cumulative looks.
